material_art.provenance: Original VoxelCraft procedural pixel art, v0.18 track 3 (2026-11-23 and 24, five rounds): deepslate, andesite, diorite, granite, tuff, cobblestone, gravel, dirt, grass top and sides, sand, red sand, the sixteen stone and deepslate ores, nine leaves, the logs, log ends and planks of oak, spruce, birch, jungle, acacia, dark oak, mangrove, cherry and pale oak, the stripped logs and ends of the same nine, sandstone and red sandstone (sides, tops, bottom, cut), coarse dirt, podzol, mycelium, rooted dirt, clay, bedrock, polished andesite, diorite, granite, tuff and deepslate, cobbled deepslate, and (third round) stone bricks and their mossy, cracked and chiseled forms, bricks, nether, red nether, end stone and prismarine bricks, mud, packed mud and mud bricks, deepslate bricks and tiles, the tuff bricks and chiseled tuffs, blackstone and its polished, brick, chiseled and gilded forms, calcite, smooth stone, the chiseled sandstones, stripped bamboo, azalea and flowering azalea leaves, plain and the sixteen coloured terracottas, and (fourth round) quartz and purpur, the copper blocks, cut, chiseled, grates and bulbs in every oxidation stage, concrete, concrete powder and wool in all sixteen colours, the ore blocks, raw ore blocks and amethyst, the Nether's natural blocks, end stone, obsidian and crying obsidian, and (fifth round) the copper doors, trapdoors, bars, chains, lanterns, chests and lightning rods through every oxidation stage, the iron door and trapdoor, bars, chain and lanterns, the crimson and warped stems, ends and planks, bone blocks, ice, blue ice, frosted ice, snow and powder snow, and the workstations' faces (crafting table, furnace, smithing table, bookshelf and chiseled bookshelf, composter, barrel, smoker, blast furnace, cartography and fletching tables, grindstone, lectern, loom and stonecutter); then v1.0 track 10 (2026-11-25, src/render/final_art_textures.rs): the wooden doors and trapdoors of all thirteen woods, the chest and trapped chest, the dirt path, hay bale, bell, anvil and its damaged stages, TNT, and the plants (flowers, tall flowers, saplings, grasses and ferns, the crops at every age, mushrooms, fungi and the other cross-model plants); then v1.0 track 10b (2026-11-26, src/render/final_art_b_textures.rs): the lily pad, pink petals, wildflowers and leaf litter, vines and glow lichen, the coral blocks, corals, coral fans and wall fans alive and dead, sea pickles, the bamboo stalk and its leaves, the potted torchflower and the ender chest; then v1.0 gap track 7 (2026-11-27, src/render/final_art_c_textures.rs): the amethyst buds (small, medium, large) and cluster standing and hanging, the bamboo's small and large leaves redrawn for the crossed planes leafy bamboo draws beside its post, the potted bamboo's cane, and its single leaf on the one new layer (4066); then v1.0 gap track 6b (2026-11-27, src/content/item_models.rs, not part of this generator): the spore blossom's petal and base and the small dripleaf's leaf and stems for their 3D item models, on Track 6's reserved layers 4080-4083, which grow the block array to 4084 layers. Integer palette-and-cluster rules from docs/art-and-ui.md; no Minecraft texture was copied or traced
